card.essence: Apis is the remedy of stinging, burning pains and rapid oedematous swellings affecting cellular tissues, serous membranes, and skin. The patient is intensely aggravated by heat in any form and ameliorated by cold applications. Erysipelas, dropsical effusions, and suppressed eruptions with bag-like swellings, especially around eyes, characterise its sphere. Thirstlessness during fever and dropsy is marked.

keynotes.text: Stinging, burning pains like bee stings; sharp and sudden
Bag-like, puffy oedema; eyelids like water bags
Extreme aggravation from heat; relief from cold applications
Thirstlessness in dropsy and during fever
Sudden shrill, piercing screams (cri encéphalique) in brain disease
Erysipelas with rosy-red hue, swelling, and sensitiveness
Anus feels wide open; involuntary diarrhoea on motion

modalities_worse.text: Heat in any form: warm room, hot weather, warm drinks, fire, bed, hot bath
Touch; extreme sensitiveness even to hair

modalities_better.text: Cold: open air, cold bathing, cold applications, uncovering

mentals: Irritable, nervous, fidgety, hard to please
Weeping disposition; cannot help crying; tearful without cause
Awkward; drops things readily (women, widows, children, girls)
Cannot concentrate when reading or studying
Ailments from jealousy, fright, rage, vexation, grief, bad news
physicals: Rapid oedematous swelling; pits upon pressure
Eyelids swollen like water bags; conjunctiva bright red, puffy
Tongue fiery red, swollen, raw, vesicles; feels scalded
Throat: constricted, glossy as if varnished, inside and out swollen
Right ovary especially affected; ovarian tumours, cysts
Urine: scanty, bloody, frequent, involuntary; burning on urination; suppressed with casts
Incontinence; cannot retain urine a moment; scalds severely
Constipation with sensation as if something tight would break on straining
Suffocation; dyspnoea, feels as if cannot draw another breath
clinical: Erysipelas of face with rosy-red hue and rapid swelling
Diphtheria with rapid oedematous closure of throat; painless or stinging
Hydrocephalus, cerebro-spinal meningitis with cri encéphalique
Ovarian cysts and tumours, especially right
Keratitis with intense chemosis; perforating corneal ulcer
Pericarditis, pleuritic effusion with serous inflammation

differentials.note: Arsenicum has burning relieved by heat; Apis burning relieved by cold. Arsenicum thirsty; Apis thirstless in dropsy.
Disagrees when used before or after Apis. Both have oedema but Rhus worse from cold/damp, better warmth; Apis opposite.
Phosphorus has oedema of whole face; Apis especially around and under eyes. Both have involuntary diarrhoea.
Kali carb. has oedema of upper lids; Apis lower lids like water bags.
Both weepy and thirstless. Apis more stinging pains, worse heat; Pulsatilla mild, yielding, changeable.
Baptisia painless throat but swelling not as rapid as Apis and no oedema.
Both worse from warm bath in brain congestion with convulsions.

cautions: Disagrees when used either before or after Rhus toxicodendron
Warm bathing contraindicated in convulsions needing Apis; may precipitate fits
In suppressed eruptions with brain symptoms, act promptly to prevent meningitis
